reviews.official_motion_text:
a) That it is the opinion of Council that the public interest requires that persons other than members
         of Council and Officers be excluded from the meeting to consider confidential information regarding
         the acquisition, disposition or expropriation of land or improvements, if the council considers that
         disclosure could reasonably be expected to harm the interests of the municipality; and negotiations
         and related discussions respecting the proposed provision of a municipal service that are at their
         preliminary stages and that, in the view of the council, could reasonably be expected to harm the
         interests of the municipality if they were held in public; under Section 90 (1) (e) and (k) of the

reviews.original_motion_text: THAT Committee of the Whole receive this report for information; AND THAT the Committee recommend that: 1) Council directs staff to prepare a Standing Internal Borrowing Governance Bylaw; 2) Council directs staff to prepare a Remediation Plan for all internal debt balances outstanding as of December 31, 2025 and present this to Council in advance of the 2027 Financial Plan; AND 3) Council directs staff to amend all relevant policies to align with the requirements of the new Internal Borrowing Governance Bylaw once adopted.
reviews.official_motion_text:
THAT Committee of the Whole receive this report for information;
               AND
               THAT the Committee recommend that:
               1. Council directs staff to prepare a Standing Internal Borrowing Governance Bylaw for
               Council's consideration, establishing the following minimum requirements for all future
               interfund borrowing under Community Charter:
                       a. The term of any internal loan.
                       b. A formal Internal Loan Agreement.
                       c. The Interest calculated using a publicly defined methodology.
                       d. The specific Internal Loan Agreement and its repayment schedule to be
                       attached as a schedule or appendix to the annual Five-Year Financial Plan Bylaw.
               2. Council directs staff to prepare a Remediation Plan for all internal debt balances
               outstanding as of December 31, 2025, and present this Plan to Council in advance of the
               2027 Financial plan. The Remediation Plan shall include at a minimum:

      Calculate the total accrued foregone interest on all existing internal debt.
      Establish a repayment schedule for all principal and accrued interest, with a specified
      repayment period.
      Identify the proposed funding source for the required interest and principal repayments;
      AND
      3. Council directs staff to amend all relevant policies, to align fully with the requirements
      of the new Internal Borrowing Governance Bylaw once adopted.
reviews.full_formal_witness:
MOVED BY: YACUCHA
               SECONDED: WAGNER
               THAT Committee of the Whole receive this report for information;
               AND
               THAT the Committee recommend that:
               1. Council directs staff to prepare a Standing Internal Borrowing Governance Bylaw for
               Council's consideration, establishing the following minimum requirements for all future
               interfund borrowing under Community Charter:
                       a. The term of any internal loan.
                       b. A formal Internal Loan Agreement.
                       c. The Interest calculated using a publicly defined methodology.
                       d. The specific Internal Loan Agreement and its repayment schedule to be
                       attached as a schedule or appendix to the annual Five-Year Financial Plan Bylaw.
               2. Council directs staff to prepare a Remediation Plan for all internal debt balances
               outstanding as of December 31, 2025, and present this Plan to Council in advance of the
               2027 Financial plan. The Remediation Plan shall include at a minimum:

      Calculate the total accrued foregone interest on all existing internal debt.
      Establish a repayment schedule for all principal and accrued interest, with a specified
      repayment period.
      Identify the proposed funding source for the required interest and principal repayments;
      AND
      3. Council directs staff to amend all relevant policies, to align fully with the requirements
      of the new Internal Borrowing Governance Bylaw once adopted.
                                                                                       Motion CARRIED.
